candidates.change_summary: Replace the proposal counter increment `proposalCount += 1;` with `proposalCount += 2;` so each call to newGrantProposal increases proposalCount differently than in P.
Assign _usdv instead of _vader to the VADER state variable in init.
Assign _vault instead of _vader to the VADER state variable in init.
Assign address(0) instead of _vader to the VADER state variable in init.
Delete the statement that sets VADER in init, leaving it at its default zero value.
Assign the current value of the USDV state variable (set in the same call) instead of _vader to VADER.
Assign VADER's address to USDV instead of the _usdv parameter.
Assign VAULT's address to USDV instead of the _usdv parameter.
Delete the assignment to USDV so it remains address(0) after init.
Set VAULT to _vader instead of _vault, so VAULT() returns the vader address.
Set VAULT to _usdv instead of _vault, so VAULT() returns the usdv address.
Delete the VAULT assignment so VAULT stays address(0) after init.
Set coolOffPeriod to 2 instead of 1 in init.
Delete the assignment of coolOffPeriod so it remains 0 after init.
